response.sql: WITH scan_rates AS (SELECT si.healtheval, CASE WHEN s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin > 0 THEN s.gbsize / s.spanmin ELSE NULL END AS rate FROM scans s INNER JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry), status_stats AS (SELECT healtheval, COUNT(*) AS status_count, AVG(rate) AS status_avg_rate FROM scan_rates WHERE rate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY healtheval), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(status_avg_rate) AS all_avg_rate FROM status_stats), filtered_statuses AS (SELECT ss.status_count, ss.status_avg_rate, oa.all_avg_rate FROM status_stats ss, overall_avg oa WHERE oa.all_avg_rate IS NOT NULL AND ss.status_avg_rate > oa.all_avg_rate) SELECT AVG(status_avg_rate) AS average_rate, AVG(status_count) AS average_count, AVG(status_avg_rate - all_avg_rate) AS average_excess FROM filtered_statuses
